newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC surges after S&P raises ratings.
newsitem.headline: HSBC surges after S&P raises ratings.

text.p: HSBC Holdings Plc shares surged on Wednesday afternoon after international credit agency Standard & Poor's raised its long-term rating on the bank and revised its outlook to stable from positive, brokers said.
The stock surged HK$5.00 to HK$222.00 after moving narrowly between HK$216.00 and HK$218.00 for most of the morning.
"I suspect the S&P rating might help. That improves sentiment for investors in Hong Kong," said Ricky Tam, senior research manager at Delta Asia Securities.
The HSBC rally helped lift the blue-chip Hang Seng Index 219 points, or 1.58 percent, to 14,126 in the afternoon session.
